definition.text: A boy. (1.) A Canaanitish chief who joined his forces with those of Abraham in pursuit of Chedorlaomer (Gen. 14:13, 24). (2.) A city of Manasseh given to the Levites of Kohath’s family (1 Chr. 6:70).

lemmas.gloss: Aner, a Amorite, also a place in Palestine
Eshcol, the name of an Amorite, also of a valley in Pale
